message.content:
Based on my search, I found that **Epic Rap Battles of History** actually did create an official Trump vs. Clinton rap battle! Let me search for more details about the actual 2016 debates to make this script authentic.

---

# **2016 PRESIDENTIAL RAP BATTLE: HILLARY CLINTON vs. DONALD TRUMP**

## **Round 1: The Economy & Trade**

**[DJ Lester Holt drops the beat]**

**HILLARY:**
*(adjusts pantsuit, steps to the mic)*

Yo, I'm Hillary Rodham, back in the West Wing
While you were at WrestleMania, doing the body-slam thing
You got skin like Russian dressing, from too much Russian investing
Your tax returns are hiding — what you concealing, no confessing?
You stiffed your contractors, filed bankruptcy six times
Small businesses crying while you commit your white-collar crimes
I'm the most qualified candidate that's ever run for this office
You're a reality show joke — let me be honest, I'm flawless!

**TRUMP:**
*(loosens tie, grabs mic with both hands)*

WRONG! Let me just say, I respect all females
But your rhymes are trash, put 'em next to your emails!
Thirty-three thousand deleted, BleachBit, you defeated?
The FBI investigated and you should've been indicted, deleted!
I built an empire, towers with my name in gold letters
You're bought by Wall Street, all your Goldman Sachs fetters
NAFTA was a disaster, TPP you supported
Then you flipped like a pancake — voters, you aborted!

**HILLARY:**
*(pointing finger)*

You call women pigs, dogs, slobs on the daily
Miss Piggy, Miss Housekeeping — your insults are fail-y!
Alicia Machado, yeah I said her name
She's voting this November, you'll lose all the same!
You said pregnancy's an inconvenience to bosses
Your misogyny's showing, and everyone losses!

**TRUMP:**
*(leaning into mic)*

Rosie O'Donnell's vicious, everybody agrees!
I don't have time for political correctness, please!
I'm bringing jobs back from Mexico, China, Japan
While you were Secretary of State with no plan!

---

## **Round 2: Foreign Policy & National Security**

**[Beat switches — more aggressive, military drums]**

**HILLARY:**
*(measured, deliberate flow)*

You praised Putin, said he's a better leader than Obama
Every intelligence agency says Russia's the drama
You encouraged them to hack us — that's treasonous talk
You're Putin's puppet, Donald, and the world sees you walk
His walk! I was in the Situation Room when we got Bin Laden
You were firing people on The Apprentice, sad and broken-hearted
You don't even know what Aleppo is, Gary Johnson knows more!
I'll take out ISIS from Mosul to Raqqa — that's war!

**TRUMP:**
*(aggressive, interrupting)*

Wrong! Wrong! Wrong! You created ISIS, it's true!
You and Obama pulled out troops, vacuum grew!
I know more about ISIS than the generals do, believe me!
My secret plan? Element of surprise — you can't see me!
NATO's obsolete, they're not paying their share
I'll make Mexico pay for the wall, I don't care!
You're the founder of ISIS, you're the MVP
Of the worst foreign policy in all of history!

**HILLARY:**
*(shaking head)*

That's... not how any of this works, Donald, please
You said "I know words, I have the best words" — a tease
Of intelligence! Nuclear weapons? You asked why can't we use them?
Three a.m. tweet-storms? That's who you'd choose then?
You're unfit, you're unhinged, you're dangerously unstable
A man you can bait with a tweet is not able
To be commander-in-chief with the nuclear codes
You're a walking, talking, sniffing episode of implodes!

**TRUMP:**
*(sniffing audibly)*

No stamina! No stamina! She doesn't have the look!
I don't even think she has the energy to finish this book!
I'd look her in the face and tell it straight to her place
But I was going to say something rough about her family — disgrace!
I chose not to, I'm nice, I'm the nicest, believe me
Despite the hundreds of millions in negative ads to deceive me!

---

## **Round 3: Character & Fitness for Office**

**[Beat slows down — soulful, dramatic]**

**HILLARY:**
*(emotional but controlled)*

You mocked a disabled reporter, that's who you are
A Gold Star family, you attacked them — raised the bar
Of deplorable behavior, half your supporters are too
Racist, sexist, homophobic, Islamophobic — who knew?
You called John McCain not a hero, he was captured, you said
While you got five deferments for a bone spur in your head
You sacrificed nothing, compared to Khan's family
My friend, you wouldn't know sacrifice if it stabbed you, frankly!

**TRUMP:**
*(defensive, pacing)*

I like people who weren't captured, okay? I said it!
I've made sacrifices, built buildings, don't you forget it!
That tape was locker room talk, just guys being guys
Twelve women came forward? All liars and spies!
Bill Clinton was abusive to women, and YOU attacked them!
I brought your accusers to the debate, don't act like you lack them!
Juanita Broaddrick, Paula Jones, Kathleen Willey too
The Clintons are the real predators — who knew?

**HILLARY:**
*(steady, building intensity)*

This is who he is. This is who he is.
A man who can be provoked by a tweet, show biz
Over substance, over duty, over country, over all
He'd rather start a Twitter war than answer the call
Of leadership, of dignity, of presidential grace
He lacks the temperament, the judgment, to take first place
America's great because it's good, and good we must be
Not divided by fear and hate — that's not liberty!

**TRUMP:**
*(leaning back, smirking)*

Such a nasty woman! Such a nasty woman, folks!
She's got nothing, she's boring, her campaign's a hoax!
I will tell you at the time if I'll accept the results
I'll keep you in suspense — that's how I insults
The establishment! The rigged system! The whole corrupt deal!
I'm the only one who can fix it — that's the real!

---

## **FINAL VERSE: The Drop-Out**

**[Suddenly, a third figure bursts through the curtain — it's BERNIE SANDERS]**

**BERNIE:**
*(wild hair, finger pointing, Brooklyn accent)*

EXCUSE ME! EXCUSE ME! I'm here to say
Both of you are ridiculous with your ridiculous sh*t today!
Hillary with your Goldman Sachs speeches, your establishment ways
Donald with your tax cuts for billionaires, your divisive displays
I'm still here! I'm still relevant! My movement is real!
Medicare for All! Free college! That's the deal!
You two are fighting over crumbs while I want the whole bakery
The revolution continues — feel the Bern, no fakery!

**[Bernie drops the mic. Silence. Then...]**

**DJ Lester Holt:** And that concludes our debate. Please vote responsibly.

**[End scene]**

---

3. https://globalnews.ca/news/3015351/presidential-debate-2016-what-donald-trump-and-hillary-clinton-said-on-iraq-syria-and-mexico/

5. https://www.nydailynews.com/2016/11/06/election-2016-the-10-pivotal-gaffes-by-donald-trump-and-hillary-clinton/
